title: Canonical base change with ordinary module target for a relatively flat module
statement: Choose shared derived-category localizations [def-pc-derived-category]. Let f:X → S be quasi-compact and separated, and let (g′:X′ → X,f′:X′ → S′,f,g:S′ → S) be cartesian [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let G be a quasi-coherent O_X-module [pqf-def-coherent] flat over S [def-pc-scheme-module-flat-over]. Assume tensorPullback g′ [def-pc-module-pullback] is additive. There exists c:Lg′*(G[0]) → (g′*G)[0] satisfying IsDerivedModulePullbackComparison [def-pc-derived-module-base-change-map], such that the canonical derived base-change map [def-pc-derived-base-change-map] followed by Rf′*(c) is invertible. No intrinsic flatness of G over O_X is assumed.

source.place: Proof, local affine reduction, flat Cech tensor comparison, and final canonical-map identification; Stacks Tag 0A1D

proof.text: Extract the left-derived counit from choose_spec of exists_derivedPullback. Identify its recorded tensor functor with tensorPullback using Functor.ext and the object and map equalities. At G in degree zero, compose this counit with Qh of the single/tensor comparison. This explicitly constructs c and its module-comparison predicate.

Use the affine calculation as the hypothesis of the affine restriction lemma. Index opens W by pairs of affine opens V,W with W contained in the inverse image of V. The affine-open bases ensure these W cover S'. Apply the restriction lemma to each pair.

For every integer n, commute exact restriction with the derived homology functor. The restricted cohomology maps are invertible. Reflect through the over equivalence and apply sheaf-module isomorphism locality on the constructed open cover. DerivedCategory.isIso_iff then gives invertibility of the original composite.

proof_origin.place: Explicit comparison construction, affine local computation, affine-open covering, and cohomology sheaf locality

theorem exists_isIso_canonicalModuleBaseChange_of_isFlatOver
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [QuasiCompact f] [IsSeparated f]
    (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ S')
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) [(Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').Additive]
    (G : X.Modules) [SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent.{u} G]
    (hflat : Scheme.Modules.IsFlatOver G f) :
    ∃ c : (derivedPullback g').obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G) ⟶
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X'.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').obj G),
      IsDerivedModulePullbackComparison g' G c ∧
        IsIso (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f f' g g' sq.w
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
              (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G) ≫
          (schemeDerivedDirectImage f').map c)
